question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a purple ball, Eve has a silver ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) pink ball
(C) orange ball
(D) purple ball
(E) silver ball
(F) green ball
(G) grey ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (white, pink, orange, purple, silver, green, grey)
1. Eve ↔ Bob: (white, silver, orange, purple, pink, green, grey)
2. Claire ↔ Alice: (orange, silver, white, purple, pink, green, grey)
3. Claire ↔ Eve: (orange, silver, pink, purple, white, green, grey)
4. Eve ↔ Bob: (orange, white, pink, purple, silver, green, grey)
5. Gertrude ↔ Alice: (grey, white, pink, purple, silver, green, orange)
6. Eve ↔ Fred: (grey, white, pink, purple, green, silver, orange)
7. Bob ↔ Claire: (grey, pink, white, purple, green, silver, orange)
Fred has the silver ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
